findings.description: 'Скобки для людей, а не только для Python' example computed 4+7+9/3 and labeled the result '12.0 — НЕПРАВИЛЬНО!' in a source comment, but the actual value under Python 3.14 is 14.0 (verified by direct execution) — the comment was itself factually wrong.
findings.resolution: Corrected the comment in scripts/build_chapter_05.py from '# 12.0' to '# 14.0'; verified via `python3 -c "print(4+7+9/3)"` -> 14.0.
